# PrimeForge — High-Performance Web Development & AI Agents Studio

> PrimeForge is a digital studio founded by lead full-stack architect Kartik Sharma. We build custom, ultra-fast Next.js 16 web applications, modern AI chatbots with RAG vector search, and autonomous workflow automations for ambitious businesses.

## System Capabilities & Services

### 1. Custom Web Application Engineering
- 100% custom-coded React 19 & Next.js 16 applications — zero bloated WordPress/Elementor templates.
- Sub-second load speeds (0.2s - 0.4s average PageSpeed 99-100/100).
- Smooth 60fps animations powered by Framer Motion and Lenis smooth scrolling.

### 2. Search Optimization Engine (SEO + AEO + GEO)
- Traditional SEO (Google, Bing Search Indexing & Mobile First Optimization).
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization for Voice Search & Siri/Google Assistant).
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization so your brand is cited inside ChatGPT, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Gemini).

### 3. AI Agents & Vector RAG Infrastructure
- Custom RAG Knowledge Base integration using Google Gemini API (`text-embedding-004` 768-dim vectors) & Supabase Vector Store.
- Multi-lingual & Hinglish auto-detection conversational AI chatbots.
- Upstash Redis rate-limited API endpoints.

## Featured Portfolio Systems

### OnePath — Productivity SaaS
- Category: Productivity & Goal Systems
- Status: In Development
- Live URL: https://one-path-saas.vercel.app/
- Architecture: Single-goal commitment SaaS with an AI coach (Gemini-powered), flexible goal durations, multi-pillar tracking, partner accountability real-time chat, and a monochrome design system.
- Tech Stack: Next.js 16, Supabase, Gemini API, Framer Motion.

### Sterling Luxury Listings — Luxury Real Estate
- Category: High-Ticket Real Estate Platform
- Status: Delivered Studio Build
- Live URL: https://a2-realtor.netlify.app/
- Architecture: Ultra-luxury property showcase with 60fps walkthroughs, instant Cal.com scheduling embed, and integrated lead scoring.
- Tech Stack: Next.js 16, Framer Motion, Cal.com Embed, AEO/GEO Optimized.

### Protein Coach AI — AI Nutrition Tracker
- Category: AI-Powered Fitness Web App
- Status: Live Production
- Live URL: https://protein-coach-tracker-g6cx.vercel.app/
- Architecture: Full-stack nutrition app where users input meal logs and receive AI-generated protein breakdowns and daily coaching feedback.
- Tech Stack: Next.js, Supabase, OpenAI API, Tailwind v4.
